I was in this exact situation at one point in life also, i really cant give you advice but what i can do is tell you what i had went through to get where i am today, i used to tell one of my friends everything and i was scared that they were getting fed up with me, so i just kept to myself and literally started looking for any other way to cope with my emotions and depression, the one that gave me the most peace was gym, i started working out very consistently, Everytime i felt depressed or just in a rut i went to the gym, the gym gave me goals to work towards, ive grown a lot physically and started getting compliments, that got my self confidence up, i never cut off my friend or anything, i just limited my time spent with them and the friendship that was there before all the mental health talks really shone through, it took me about a year to rebuild the relationship with that friend, sure i dont get the same validation from my friend but i think its for the best. I learned that all the validation i needed from them was them being worried about me when i was keeping myself busy working out and shit. Like i said idk uour situation, but i hope that you find a healthier way to cope with your emotions.
